title: AgentGraphPackage
description: A Cavelon solution package, format v3. Optional sections and fields are added without a new major version; an instance accepts its current major and the two before it, and drops one only after 12 months' notice.

PackageKbOrderProfile.description:
One knowledge-base order profile, by names that survive the move.

The tenant stores ids (``settings.kb_orders.profiles``); the package names the
template knowledge base by its name and the answering solution by its slug,
and the import resolves both to the target tenant's own rows.
PackageKbOrderProfile.title: PackageKbOrderProfile

PackageKbOrderSettings.title: PackageKbOrderSettings

PackageRequiredValue.description:
A variable or secret the package's solutions need the target to set.

A value never travels in a package; the name does, so the import preview can
list what the target still has to set, and the target's secrets list shows
it as not set until someone does.
PackageRequiredValue.title: PackageRequiredValue

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: The spec of a case of type 'trigger'; absent on a chat case.

TriggerCaseDocument.description:
A knowledge-base document the case hands to the run, named rather than by id.

A shipped suite cannot know a tenant's document ids. The runner picks the
newest ready document of the named knowledge base, or the one with this
title, and puts its id into the run's input as ``attached_documents``.
TriggerCaseDocument.title: TriggerCaseDocument

TriggerFileCheck.description: A check on one file in the bound Sandbox after the run.
TriggerFileCheck.title: TriggerFileCheck

TriggerLoopExpectations.description: What a Masterloop the run started may spend, and how it must end.
TriggerLoopExpectations.title: TriggerLoopExpectations

TriggerOutputCheck.description: A check on the run's output; ``json_path`` reads into a structured output.
TriggerOutputCheck.title: TriggerOutputCheck

TriggerRuntimeRequirement.description:
The Sandbox a case needs, described, never named by id.

The same shape a package's runtime requirement has, so a suite stays
portable: each target binds its own test Sandbox, and the runner checks the
one the run actually used against this.
TriggerRuntimeRequirement.title: TriggerRuntimeRequirement

TriggerCaseSpec.description: Start a trigger of the suite's solution, wait for the run, check what it left.

documents.description: Knowledge-base documents to hand to the run, by knowledge base and optional title. Their ids reach the run's input as 'attached_documents'; a case whose document is missing fails and names it.
documents.title: Documents

expect_status.description: How the run must end. 'reaches_approval' passes when the run reaches an Approval node, its own or one in its Masterloop's iteration solution: a test run ends there, approves nothing and runs nothing after it, and the output checks read the content that waits for the decision.
expect_status.title: Expect Status

approval_node.description: With 'reaches_approval': the slug of the Approval node the run must reach, in the workflow or its Masterloop's iteration; any one if absent.
approval_node.title: Approval Node

TriggerCaseSpec.title: TriggerCaseSpec

registry_entities.title: Registry Entities
registry_entities.description: Sections generated from the snapshot registry, keyed by section. A section the package omits leaves the target's rows as they are.
